candidates.term: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate
candidates.defline: The Alchemist lives inside your Year Gate: your root drinks from an odd, deep well.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family, Mind, and Growth, and it works from the root of your story. The Alchemist lives inside your Year Gate: nurture came to you sideways, through books, silence, an unconventional guardian, or a house where love spoke in ideas. It built a mind that feeds itself. Solitude restores you, and always will, so treat it as nutrition rather than absence. Family may stay slightly puzzled by you, lovingly. Growth arrives through the unusual door in every era of your life. Keep walking through those. The conventional ones were never locked. They were just empty.
candidates.teaser: Your roots hold an unusual nurture: care that came sideways, through books, silence, or an unconventional guardian. Solitude restores you, and always will.
